what: 400 SNTP requests to time.google.com on one connected UDP socket, 0.2 s apart, 2 s timeout (itb's old loop); each request carries a nonce as its transmit timestamp, so a reply whose originate field is not the current nonce is a reply to an earlier request
reading: the network delivered some replies twice; every duplicate pushed the queue one request further behind, and a reader without the originate check took each queued reply for the answer to the request just sent (wait 0.1-0.4 ms, offset wrong by the request spacing)
